name: Devin Review
desc: Review surface where Devin walks through a pull request with you.
desc_zh: 和 Devin 一起逐个过 Pull Request 的审查界面。
solves: Reviewing agent-written diffs by scrolling leaves you guessing at intent; the agent explains each change and you answer it inline.
solves_zh: 滚动浏览智能体写的 diff 只能靠猜意图；现在智能体会逐段解释改动，你当场追问。
best_for: A large agent pull request lands and you need to understand it before approving.
best_for_zh: 一个很大的智能体 Pull Request 进来，批准前想先弄懂它。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cognition.com/blog directory）。 Distinct review surface inside the Devin product; a Review 2.0 followed on 2026-11-05 and it reached Windsurf on 2026-05-06. 首次公开日期来源：https://cognition.com/blog/devin-review
